column3: internal/notify/templates.go (Template, SaveTemplate, DefaultTemplates, SeedTemplates) backs the staff editor at PUT /api/v1/staff/notification-templates/{event_key}, with subject, body and in-app title/body/url edited in web/src/views/notification-templates.ts.

Per-template enabled, mail_enabled and in_app_enabled columns (internal/store/migrations/0020_commerce.sql) are enforced by notify.dispatch in internal/notify/events.go and written through templateBody in internal/httpapi/notifications.go.

internal/notify/preferences.go implements force, choice_on, choice_off and never, SetPreference refuses an opt-out of a force event, and GET/PUT /api/v1/portal/notifications/preferences in internal/httpapi/notifications.go serve the set.

internal/notify/inbox.go with handleListNotifications, handleUnreadCount, handleMarkNotificationRead and handleMarkAllNotificationsRead in internal/httpapi/notifications.go backs web/src/views/portal-notifications.ts, and every row carries a url for the deep link.

internal/notify/push.go and internal/notify/webpush/vapid.go plus the push settings group (enabled, vapid_public_key, vapid_private_key, subject) serve GET /api/v1/push/config, POST /api/v1/push/subscriptions and POST /api/v1/push/test.

handleEmailLog at GET /api/v1/staff/logs/email in internal/httpapi/logs.go lists notification_deliveries with to, subject, status, error and sent_at, and internal/retention/retention.go ages the table out.

notify.Catalogue in internal/notify/events.go lists twelve templated events, but new_invoice_created still sends the hardcoded notify.InvoiceIssuedMessage, invoice_payment_failed and server_suspended have no call site, and new_ticket_message fires only from internal/tickets/piping.go rather than the portal and staff reply handlers.
Template.CC and Template.BCC in internal/notify/templates.go (cc_addresses, bcc_addresses columns) are fanned out as byte-identical copies by enqueueMail in internal/notify/events.go.
No test-email route exists (only POST /api/v1/push/test for push) and no cron-failure mail is sent, while cron and worker failures are recorded in error_logs through internal/httpapi/logs.go.

The mail settings group in internal/settings/settings.go (disable, must_verify, smtp_host, smtp_port, smtp_username, smtp_password, smtp_encryption, smtp_from) is editable via PUT /api/v1/staff/settings and web/src/views/system-settings.ts, with the password returned only as is_set.
internal/notify/templates.go and notify.SMTPSender are plain text only: there is no HTML mail, no header or footer hook and no CSS branding anywhere in the render path.

notify.Queue in internal/notify/notify.go writes notification_deliveries with attempts, error and dedupe_key (internal/store/migrations/0024_notification_dedupe.sql) and the worker drains it with retries.

internal/growth/discord.go DiscordNotifier, the discord settings group and PUT /api/v1/staff/discord exist with selectable events, but no production call site invokes Notify so no event actually reaches the webhook.
The OnNewDevice hook installed by httpapi.Server.WithAuth in internal/httpapi/server.go calls notify.NewLogin, which renders the new_login_detected template with login_at, ip_address and user_agent.

internal/register/register.go creates users, customers and customer_accounts in one transaction behind POST /api/v1/auth/register with captcha and accept_tos, and web/src/views/login.ts links to /register.
POST /api/v1/auth/login in internal/httpapi/auth.go verifies an Argon2id hash through internal/authn/password.go and applies the per-address throttle in internal/authn/session.go.

internal/authn/mfa.go implements TOTP enrolment, recovery codes returned once, a challenge-token second step and a DisableMFA that demands password and code, while web/src/views/portal-security.ts and web/src/views/settings.ts drive it through web/src/lib/mfa.ts, which draws the QR locally with web/src/lib/qr.ts.

authn.RequestEmailVerification and authn.VerifyEmail in internal/authn/reset.go store a hashed single-use token and answer non-enumerating 202s, served by POST /api/v1/auth/verify/request and GET /api/v1/auth/verify.

authn.RequestPasswordReset and authn.ResetPassword in internal/authn/reset.go use a hashed single-use token and revoke every session in the same transaction, served by POST /api/v1/auth/password-reset/request and /complete.
register.Service.ChangePassword in internal/register/register.go is exposed as POST /api/v1/auth/password/change in internal/httpapi/register.go and used by web/src/views/portal-security.ts.

Google works as a row in social_providers (internal/store/migrations/0038_oauth.sql) managed at /api/v1/staff/oauth-providers and used by the public /oauth/social/{slug}/start and /callback routes in internal/httpapi/social.go.

GitHub is an operator-created row in social_providers with configurable authorization, token and userinfo endpoints plus subject and email claims, driven by internal/oauth/social.go and listed on the sign-in screen from GET /api/v1/auth/providers.

Discord is a social_providers row configured through web/src/views/providers.ts and authenticated by the generic OAuth2 flow in internal/oauth/social.go, including the account-exists refusal instead of a silent merge.

OAuth client records with redirect URIs and secret regeneration live at GET/POST /api/v1/staff/oauth-clients, POST /api/v1/staff/oauth-clients/{id}/rotate-secret and DELETE /api/v1/staff/oauth-clients/{id}/secret in internal/httpapi/oauth.go, edited by web/src/views/oauth-clients.ts.

internal/httpapi/oauth.go serves GET and POST /oauth/authorize and POST /oauth/token with signed keys from migration 0038_oauth.sql, and scoped bearer access to GET /api/v1/me and /api/v1/me/invoices.

api_keys (internal/store/migrations/0014_account_lifecycle.sql) carries last_used_at and an ip_allowlist checked on every request by apiKeyIdentity in internal/httpapi/auth.go, with GET/PUT /api/v1/staff/api-keys/{id}/ip-allowlist in internal/httpapi/apikeys_ext.go and revoke in internal/httpapi/apikeys.go.

POST /api/v1/staff/roles, PATCH /api/v1/staff/roles/{id}, PUT /api/v1/staff/roles/{id}/permissions and DELETE /api/v1/staff/roles/{id} in internal/httpapi/roles_ext.go edit roles against the served GET /api/v1/staff/permissions, and authn.ErrSystemRole in internal/authn/roles.go keeps the four built-in roles immutable.

POST /api/v1/staff/users/{id}/impersonate and POST /api/v1/portal/impersonation/stop in internal/httpapi/impersonate.go write an audit row before the session is usable, refuse staff targets, and web/src/app.ts renders the banner from session.impersonating.

GET /api/v1/portal/sessions with DELETE /api/v1/portal/sessions/{id} and POST /api/v1/portal/sessions/revoke-others in internal/httpapi/sessions.go back the session list in web/src/views/portal-security.ts, and staff get GET/DELETE /api/v1/staff/sessions.

Sessions record ip and user_agent for display in internal/authn/session.go but nothing validates them on later requests, and internal/settings/settings.go has no security group or bind-to-IP or bind-to-agent key.
GET /api/v1/portal/login-history and the staff GET /api/v1/staff/security/sign-ins in internal/httpapi/sessions.go and sessions_ext.go read auth_events, rendered by web/src/views/security.ts.

internal/captcha/captcha.go verifies Turnstile, reCAPTCHA and hCaptcha from the captcha settings group, internal/captcha/origins.go widens the CSP by exactly the configured provider's origins, and web/src/lib/captcha.ts mounts the widget on web/src/views/register.ts and web/src/views/forgot-password.ts.

general.tos in internal/settings/settings.go makes acceptance mandatory through Policy.TOSRequired in internal/register/register.go and the checkout guard, and web/src/views/register.ts renders the accept_tos box.
BILLING_TRUSTED_PROXIES is parsed and applied only for listed CIDRs through the TrustedProxies option on httpapi.Auth in cmd/billing/serve.go.
general.registration_disabled is checked by register.Service before any write and answers 403 registration_disabled from POST /api/v1/auth/register, editable in web/src/views/system-settings.ts.

The staff API now covers every listed resource: /api/v1/staff/users and /customers (internal/httpapi/users.go, customers_staff.go), /invoices with lines and /credit-notes, /tickets with /{id}/replies, /orders, /services, /coupons, /credit/grants and /credit/debits, /catalog/products, /catalog/categories and /config-options.

internal/openapi generates the specification with internal/openapi/parity_test.go failing on drift, the typed client lives in apiclient and the descriptions are maintained in internal/openapi/descriptions_*.go.

api_keys with prefix, digest, scopes, expiry, revoke and last_used_at in internal/authn/apikey.go and internal/httpapi/apikeys.go serve the personal-token role, managed from web/src/views/api-keys.ts.
